_source: The photographs the showcase pages use. Read by scripts/make_hero_images.py --import (which makes the files) and by website/_src/showcase.py (which writes the <picture> elements). 'from' is the file's name in the folder it was imported from and is never published; 'stem' is the name it is published under. Every one of these is a STOCK or licensed studio photograph, not the work of an academy learner: 'stock' is true, the alt text describes the hair and nothing else, and the build refuses any alt text that claims it as a learner's or student's work. Mark's decision, 20 Nov 2026: use these now; the licence paperwork follows (TODO_PM).

licence.value: Written permission or licence for each photograph, held on file
